newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian soldier, who killed six, captured.
newsitem.headline: Russian soldier, who killed six, captured.

text.p: A Russian soldier, who killed an unarmed lieutenant and five soldiers with an assault rifle and fled his unit in the Far East, was captured on Saturday, Interfax news agency said.
Interfax gave no details of the operation to hunt down private Yevgeny Gorbunov but said he had been captured with a Kalashnikov assault rifle and ammunition.

Itar-Tass news agency said on Friday the accused 20-year-old soldier had waited until fellow conscripts near the city of Gusinoozyorsk put away their assault rifles after they returned to their unit from a military depot they were guarding.
He then opened fire on the men, killing them on the spot. Tass said five other soldiers were in the building, but did not say what happened to them. It was not clear what was behind the attack.
Incidents involving soldiers shooting each other have become common in recent years as low morale and cash shortages have taken their toll on Russia's once-mighty military machine.
